lead: A test that reads `nvs_codegen::disassemble` is x86_64-only until it says which backend it means.
body: Cranelift prints the vcode of whichever backend it emitted for, so a scan for lines beginning `call ` counts zero on aarch64 (`bl 0`, `blr <reg>`) — a structurally empty answer that a "no more calls than sites" guard passes while looking at nothing. Anything walking calls or branches out of the disassembly wants a `target_arch` gate, as `perf_guards.rs`'s `path_calls` has; macos-aarch64 is in the test matrix.
